title: phlomoides glabra
intro: Phlomoides glabra, commonly known as Smooth Phlomoides, is a plant species belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae) and is native to the mountainous regions of China. The health benefits of Phlomoides glabra include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which have been used to treat various ailments such as fever, cough, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to relax muscles, reduce stress and anxiety, and aid in respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Phlomoides glabra include iridoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
